doc: Copies an 8-byte global lookup table onto the stack and returns the byte at the offset (a0->field_0x14 & 7). This is a struct-copy-then-mask-index idiom typical of small circular/lookup tables.

globals.name: D_80080B20
globals.decl: extern struct { u8 b[8]; } D_80080B20;  /* 8-byte lookup table, accessed as a byte array via a masked index */
